newsitem.title: USA: NOAA begins $25 mln boat buyback for New England.
newsitem.headline: NOAA begins $25 mln boat buyback for New England.

text.p: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration begins taking applications to buy boats from New England fishermen this week, officials said.

"We're looking to get the biggest bang for our buck," explained NOAA spokesman Matt Stout who said the $25 million program will be offered to fishermen in Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Rhode Island.
The objective of the program, called the Fishing Capacity Reduction Initiative, is to try and remove vessels from the overfished waters of New England.
A $2 million pilot program earlier this year resulted in 11 boats being pulled from the waters. "We had a tremendous response," Stout said, noting there were 114 applications for that money.
The program uses a formula that computes how much a fishing a vessel does, how much the vessel is worth and "basically how many fish can we save for the dollar," Stout said.
